surface_model.rule: Examples are documentary labels, not an exhaustive product enum. A binding self-identifies its actual supported surface and current tool exposure.

capability_discovery.forbidden_assumption: No product-wide tool, plugin, MCP, web, file, scheduling, image, application-action, or external-service list is treated as permanently available.

approvals: Transport HostApprovalEvidence separately from Blu AuthorizationResult.
host_session_evidence: Emit only supported provider evidence. Chat/conversation/project identity alone yields correlation_only at most and cannot qualify protected cross-turn continuation.
authorization_transport: If verified identity/role/credential evidence is not exposed through a supported interface, return unavailable or insufficient; product sign-in is not promoted.
time_mapping: Map an exposed current-time provider to a receipted time result; otherwise exact current time is unknown/unavailable even when deployment date context exists.
scheduling_mapping: Map an exposed Scheduled provider to create/update/cancel/recurrence operations and provider schedule receipts. Documentary availability on some surfaces does not prove the current chat exposes it.
artifact_mapping: Distinguish requested, attempted, created, and verified states using host object references or provider evidence; do not invent filesystem paths.
